question: Can a source-driven return packet reliably work across one garden of public and authorized private organs without creating false status or a self-refresh loop?
goal: Preserve owner decisions and current code status without README upkeep and measure actual re-entry in fresh chats.

observations.claim: One garden with many organs; do not force conventional product divisions. Private repos count. README can be optional.
Authenticated GitHub listing returned 110 visible repositories, including 18 private, in two pages; public atlas reported 92 public.
GHoT Garden Pulse #139 merged, includes source-driven generator and read-only private-aware inventory.
Three Python unittest fixture tests passed: include private repos, paginate 110 entries, and exclude source-refresh commit from generated status.
Scheduled workflow, private cross-repo runtime discovery and fresh-chat end-to-end retrieval remain unverified.

rival_models.hypothesis: The missing trigger is retrieval, not persistence.
rival_models.falsifier: Fresh chat correctly retrieves sources unaided but still loses recorded intent.

rival_models.hypothesis: Status pages mislead because they are static or self-refreshing.
rival_models.falsifier: Stable deterministic pulse with explicit PR/deployment distinctions still drifts at the same rate.

rival_models.hypothesis: Private repo exclusion was responsible for missing cross-project context.
rival_models.falsifier: Full authorized private/public retrieval adds no relevant missing decisions in matched prompts.

rival_models.hypothesis: Foundation/intent capture remains the limiting step even with auto status.
rival_models.falsifier: Source-derived GitHub facts alone recover all recorded user corrections.
Task-specific source retrieval consistently outperforms a global index dump, keeping authority and privacy bounded.

next_probe: Blind new conversation: ask about a current HUMKIN radio requirement and its relationship to private Groove Rooms return-address and GHoT task receipts; compare with baseline that sees only public GitBook. Require exact private/public coverage, source version, latest correction, PR state and next test.
expected_failure_modes: Private repo not discovered despite authorization
Owner intent replaced by inferred promotional README
Model claims successful tool run without evidence
